subject: Human Evolution
title: Ghost Lineages
description: A quick win: understand Ghost Lineages.

hook.text: DNA from modern West Africans contains traces of an unknown human species—one we've never found a fossil for.

buildup.text: Statistical models detect archaic DNA segments that don't match Neanderthals, Denisovans, or known species.

discovery.text: This 'ghost population' interbred with ancestors of modern West Africans within the last 200,000 years.

twist.text: There may be several ghost lineages in human DNA—extinct relatives we can only detect genetically.

climax.text: Our genome is a graveyard of species we haven't yet dug up—ancient relatives known only through their genes.

punchline.text: Some ancestors left DNA but no bones.

quiz.question: What are 'ghost lineages' in human genetics?
options: DNA from unknown extinct human species with no discovered fossils
